name: Gladiator

starting_equipment_options.desc: An inexpensive but unusual weapon, such as a trident or net

feature.name: By Popular Demand
desc: You can always find a place to perform, usually in a combat arena or an inn but possibly with a circus, at a theater, or even in a noble's court. At such a place, you receive free lodging and food of a modest or comfortable standard (depending on the quality of the establishment), as long as you perform each night. In addition, your performance makes you something of a local figure. When strangers recognize you in a town where you have performed, they typically take a liking to you.

traits: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.
Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.
Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long.
I get bitter if I'm not the center of attention.
I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.
I change my mood or my mind as quickly as I change key in a song.
ideals: Beauty. When I perform, I make the world better than it was. (Good)
Tradition. The stories, legends, and songs of the past must never be forgotten. (Lawful)
Creativity. The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)
Greed. I'm only in it for the money and fame. (Evil)
People. I like seeing the smiles on people's faces. (Neutral)
Honesty. Art should reflect the soul. (Any)
bonds: My weapon is my most treasured possession.
I want to be famous, whatever it takes.
I idolize a hero of the old tales.
I will do anything to prove myself superior to my hated rival.
I would do anything for the other members of my group.
flaws: I'll do anything to win fame and renown.
I'm a sucker for a pretty face.
A scandal prevents me from ever going home again.
I once satirized a noble who still wants my head.
I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden.
Despite my best efforts, I am unreliable to my friends.

desc: A gladiator is as much an entertainer as any minstrel or circus performer, trained to make the arts of combat into a spectacle for the crowd to enjoy. This kind of fighting is a form of performance, and you are its star.
